name: markdown
description: Build the Markdown 101 slides and handouts with Marp, using the theme in design/

scripts.slides: npm run decks && marp --no-stdin dist/markdown-101.md dist/markdown-101-microsoft.md && marp --no-stdin dist/markdown-101.md dist/markdown-101-microsoft.md --pdf && marp --no-stdin dist/markdown-101.md dist/markdown-101-microsoft.md --pptx
scripts.build: npm run slides && npm run handouts
